description: Training-curve panel (F-1.5.11): loss (train + val) and the selection metric (val AUROC) vs epoch for one representative Phase-1.5 training run, with the best / early-stopping epoch marked by a dashed vertical line. Read from the run.json training_run_record via egm-data's load_training_run_record (a run-record sidecar, not a ClassifierBank). The single inputs.groups entry's bank_id is the run's id; map it to the run.json path with --bank <run_id>=<path-to-run.json> (the resolved path is the JSON, not an HDF5 bank). 'styling.metric' (default 'auroc') picks which val_metrics series the bottom panel plots; a null / non-scalar epoch value renders as a gap. Standard ML-paper figure — usually supplementary, but worth the main body when the training story is interesting (early stopping, instability). Renders via the 'training-curve' recipe. Swap in your own run.json when wiring real data.
